manualPassAudit.stratification: one fresh automated PASS sampled from each clinical family

items.note: STEMI urgent reperfusion item remained clinically coherent and single-best-answer.

Explanation asserted CHA2DS2-VASc score 3 but described age 74 as +2 and then listed +2 +1 +1 while still totalling 3. Correct age 65-74 weighting is +1. The treatment answer was reasonable, but the explanation contained unsafe/internally inconsistent score arithmetic and should not have passed.
Warfarin during breastfeeding with a mechanical valve was supported and unambiguous.
Paediatric DKA with suspected cerebral oedema had an appropriate immediate hypertonic-saline management decision.
Dysphagia urgent suspected-cancer referral item was supported and single-best-answer.
NEWS2 plus clinical judgement risk-stratification item was supported and fair.

manualFailureAudit.stratification: one fresh automated FAIL sampled from each clinical family

items.note: Immediate CPAP timing was more specific than the verified packet boundary, which only supported considering NIV in the stated setting.
Fresh failed variant did not clear the strict anticoagulation boundary; no gate weakening indicated.
Varicella post-exposure prophylaxis item omitted confirmed susceptibility and sufficiently precise exposure timing.
Bronchiolitis oxygen-threshold options overlapped; multiple formulations could justify oxygen at the stated saturation.
Postmenopausal bleeding while on combined HRT required HRT-specific decision context that the packet did not resolve; explanation improperly tried to dismiss that modifier.
The vignette stated NEWS2 7 rather than supplying independently reproducible raw observations; deterministic numerical guard correctly rejected it.

highestLeverageDefect.name: named-clinical-score arithmetic can survive inside explanations
highestLeverageDefect.why: A fresh automated PASS contained internally inconsistent and clinically incorrect CHA2DS2-VASc arithmetic. This directly falsifies the desired invariant that automated PASS means publishable and occurred in the lowest-performing family.
highestLeverageDefect.fix: Extend the strict named-score rule from vignette to explanation: generator must reason from raw components and verified thresholds without asserting a numeric named-score total, and a deterministic validator rejects numeric named-score assertions in explanations before reviewer acceptance.
highestLeverageDefect.gateImpact: strictness increased; no safety, ambiguity, source-support, numerical, fallback-template, or SBA gate weakened
